job.title: Supervising Pharmacist
job.description:
Supervising Pharmacist - Co. Galway

Closed Sundays & bank holidays.

  • 4-5 days p/w, 9:30-6
  • 2 sats p/m (9:30-1:30)
  • €50p/h
  • Pension
  • MPS software
  • 1 Experienced tech (10yrs+)

Ensuring the pharmacy is fully compliant with the PSI regulations.

Job role

  • Assist in the professional, clinical, ethical and financial running of the pharmacy in line with company and industry regulations.
  • Day-to-day management of the pharmacy and its team.
  • Set monthly goals for the team members and incentives to motivate them
  • Create and organise health promo events and develop strategies to drive business.
  • Control the training and development of your staff, attracting, selecting and recruiting high-calibre individuals.
  • Ensure store standards and company policies are being met (With the area manager reviewing monthly KPI'S, taking corrective action and approving agreed quarterly bonuses. Ensure the store stays within budget (staff, stock, margin, overheads)
  • Optimising and overseeing operations to ensure efficiencies of the store (paperwork, company returns, storerooms, staff area cleanliness, etc)
  • Deal with problems by providing creative and practical solutions

About the store

  • Well-established pharmacy
  • McLerons dispensary system
  • Flu vaccination service (training provided)
  • 2 experienced pharmacy techs, 1 trainee tech & 1 f/t OTC assistant & 1 p/t staff
  • No Methadone patients, no needle exchange.
  • Efficiently run dispensary using software to plan and distribute workload amongst the team.

Benefits

  • 4-5 days a week (€50 p/h)
  • Bonus scheme in place based on agreed KPI’s.
  • 5% Loyalty Bonus payable after 4 years
  • 2 Saturdays per month. No late nights or Sundays
  • Free parking
  • Generous staff discount
  • Head office support for rota, policies, bulk orders, etc.
  • 1 day per month with double pharmacist cover
  • Budget for pharmacist training and travel expenses.
  • Budget for staff nights out and team building.
  • PSI Fees paid

For further details, please apply here or contact Brian Mahon on 086 7773856

job.title: General & Finishing Foremen
job.description:
FRS Recruitment are currently recruiting for experienced General & Finishing Supervisors / Foremen to join a leading Tier 1 Main Building Contractor, working across a number of major construction projects throughout Cork City and County.

Our client is one of Ireland's most established Main Contractors, with an excellent reputation for delivering high-quality construction projects across the pharmaceutical, commercial, residential and industrial sectors.

The company has a very strong pipeline of ongoing and upcoming projects throughout Cork and the wider Munster region, offering excellent long-term career opportunities and progression within the business.

We are seeking experienced General Supervisors and Finishing Supervisors / Foremen who have a strong background in large-scale building projects and are comfortable overseeing subcontractors, coordinating site activities and ensuring works are delivered to a high standard.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a well-established construction team, working on some of the largest and most interesting building projects in the Munster region.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily construction activities across major building projects.
  • Coordinate subcontractors, trades and general site operations effectively.
  • Monitor project progress against construction programmes and deadlines.
  • Ensure all works meet required quality and safety standards.
  • Supervise general building works or internal finishing packages.
  • Work closely with Site Managers, Engineers and Project Managers.
  • Identify and resolve site issues to maintain project progress.
  • Maintain high standards of workmanship, organisation and site safety.

Requirements

  • 5+ years' experience in a similar supervisory position.
  • Previous experience with a Main Building Contractor in Ireland/UK.
  • Strong background in commercial, pharmaceutical or large-scale building projects.
  • Experience managing subcontractors and coordinating multiple trades on-site.
  • Good understanding of construction sequencing, programmes and quality standards.
  • Strong communication, leadership and site management skills.
  • Ability to work independently within a larger project delivery team.
  • Relevant construction qualifications and site safety certifications desirable.

Salary & Benefits

  • Salary: €70,000 – €85,000 DOE.
  • Company vehicle and fuel card provided.
  • Company pension scheme.
  • Healthcare benefits.
  • Long-term permanent employment with an established Tier 1 Contractor.
  • Excellent pipeline of projects throughout Cork and Munster.
  • Strong opportunities for internal progression and career development.
  • Opportunity to work on major, high-profile construction projects.

job.title: Support Pharmacist
job.description:
Support Pharmacist - Tuam, Co. Galway (Maternity Contract)

I am currently recruiting a Support Pharmacist for Galway. This position is for 4 or 5 days a week, with 1 Saturday in 3. There is excellent support and conditions.

To support the Managing Pharmacist in the running of the dispensary in a busy and challenging environment. Working to agreed operating procedures within the pharmacy to maintain the highest ethical standards and deliver excellent customer care.

Duties and Responsibilities:­­­­ ­­­­­­­ ­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­­ ­

  • To strictly observe the statutory regulations relating to the supply of medicinal products as per the Pharmacy Act 2007.
  • To adhere to dispensing standard operating procedures and ensure maintenance of the appropriate records and hygiene within the pharmacy as per the Pharmacy Act 2008.
  • To ensure that any issues of a Health and Safety nature are brought to the attention of the managing pharmacist.
  • To fulfil the required advisory role concerning over-the-counter medicines and ensure that staff on the medicine counter are aware of the procedure for counter prescribing and their limitations.
  • Ensure that the proper procedure for the various Department of Health Schemes, e.g. DPS, LTI, GMS is carried out and that they are kept up to date, appropriately submitted at the end of each month, and payment is reconciled as set down by Company Procedures.
  • Maintain appropriate stock levels in the Pharmacy, ensuring the correct storage and monitoring of dated products.
  • Assume full responsibility during the absence of the Pharmacist for supervising the pharmacy in the provision of medicinal products.
  • Ensure that the Pharmacy is kept clean and tidy, and any Health and Safety issues are brought promptly to the attention of the Pharmacy Manager.
  • To ensure that while on duty, the highest standards of care and service are delivered.
  • To understand, support and participate in the retail operation of the Pharmacy.
  • To participate in training and development programmes provided by the pharmacy.
  • To keep abreast of all changes to registration and PSI practice guidance.
  • Any other duties as required

Leadership & Teamwork

  • Provide support to other stakeholders within the pharmacy to ensure the delivery of company goals.
  • This role requires a high level of proactivity and an ability to work on own initiative.
  • Build positive relationships with others in the pharmacy to create a positive working environment.
  • Participate in staff training programmes and implementation, and be proactive in developing the role function.
  • Give education & training programmes within the Pharmacy.
  • To assist the managing pharmacist in programmes of health promotion and the implementation of pharmaceutical care.

Please contact Brian on 086 7773856

job.title: Supervising Pharmacist
job.description:
Supervising Pharmacist - Dublin 4 or Dublin 6

Are you a Supervising Pharmacist and looking for a new challenge?

Reporting directly to the Superintendent Pharmacist and based at this well-established pharmacy in Dublin 4 or 6, the ideal candidate for the Supervising Pharmacist role will have experience in a Community Pharmacy setting, be positive and friendly with a can-do attitude, be a strong leader and always be willing to put the customer first.

In return, the Supervising Pharmacist will receive a competitive salary and benefits package and join an award-winning team.

Duties include but are not limited to;

  • To observe the statutory regulations relating to the supply of medicinal products as per the Pharmacy Act 2007 and to ensure operating within any changes of registration and PSI practice guidance
  • To ensure that the highest standards of care and service are delivered as part of the Pharmacy Team
  • To adhere to dispensing standard operating procedures and ensure maintenance of the appropriate records and hygiene within the pharmacy as per the Pharmacy Act 2008 and ensure that correct storage and monitoring of dated products
  • Work alongside a support pharmacist and lead and manage an established team of OTC assistants and technicians, ensuring staff are motivated. Leading processes such as performance reviews and training and development for the full team
  • To ensure that any issues of a Health and Safety nature are brought to the attention of the Superintendent Pharmacist and Area Manager immediately. Ensure that the proper procedure for the various Department of Health Schemes, e.g. DPS, LTI, GMS, is carried out and that they are kept up to date and submitted properly at the end of each month to the Head Office
  • Overseeing the management of Retail sales and assisting in Healthcare and Retail events when required
  • Supporting any change to improve the business along with senior managers
  • Providing support to other stakeholders within the pharmacy group to ensure the delivery of company goals.
  • Analysing and interpreting trends to facilitate planning
  • Participate in staff training programmes
  • Giving education & training programmes within the Pharmacy to their team.

Qualifications, Experience & Skills Required

  • A minimum of 3 years post-registration experience and currently registered. Member of the Pharmaceutical Society of Ireland with experience of the schemes in the Republic of Ireland
  • A strong sense of community and willingness to further how the Pharmacist engages with their customers locally in a friendly, professional and confidential manner
  • The successful candidate must have previous people management experience and display excellent decision-making ability and a sense of responsibility
  • Excellent attention to detail is essential, and an excellent communicator
  • A positive outlook with a friendly and approachable nature
  • Highly organised with a proven ability to work on multiple tasks accurately in a pressurised environment.
  • Ability to work on own initiative and as part of a team.
  • Flexible and willing to engage fully with all elements of the operation of the Pharmacy.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills are essential.

For further details, please apply here.

  • Knowledge of both clinical and human resource policies and procedures and relevant legislation

job.title: Accounts Administrator
job.description:
Accounts & E-Commerce Administrator

Location: East Galway
Employment: Permanent | 4 or 5 days per week
Sector: Retail

About the Role

A well-established, family-owned DIY and Agri retail business in East Galway is seeking an Accounts & E-Commerce Administrator to join its team.

This is a broad and varied role, with a strong focus on accounts administration. You will also support the day-to-day running of the business, including managing online orders, updating website products and dealing with customers and suppliers.

The role would suit someone with good accounts experience who enjoys variety and is happy to get involved in different aspects of a busy retail business.

The position can be offered on a 4 or 5-day working week.

Key Responsibilities

Accounts Administration

  • Process supplier invoices and issue customer invoices.
  • Manage accounts payable and receivable.
  • Reconcile supplier statements and customer accounts.
  • Process payments and maintain accurate financial records.
  • Follow up on outstanding payments and account queries.
  • Assist with month-end accounts and reporting.
  • Support general bookkeeping and accounts administration.

E-Commerce & Website Administration

  • Update the company website with new products, pricing and product descriptions.
  • Maintain accurate product information and availability online.
  • Process online orders and prepare dispatch documentation.
  • Liaise with couriers regarding collections and deliveries.
  • Respond to online customer queries.
  • Assist with website promotions and product updates.

Customer Service & Office Administration

  • Answer incoming calls and deal with customer and supplier queries.
  • Process customer payments over the phone.
  • Maintain office records and filing systems.
  • Assist with general office administration.
  • Provide occasional support with social media and retail promotions.
  • Support management with the day-to-day running of the business.

What We're Looking For

  • Previous experience in accounts administration, bookkeeping or a similar role.
  • Good knowledge of invoicing, payments and reconciliations.
  • Strong IT skills, particularly Excel and Microsoft Office.
  • Comfortable using websites and online systems.
  • Experience updating products on an e-commerce website would be an advantage.
  • Excellent organisational and communication skills.
  • Good attention to detail and accuracy.
  • A flexible, practical approach to work.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a small team.

Experience in a retail, wholesale or similar business would be beneficial but is not essential.

What's on Offer?

  • Permanent position with a well-established family business.
  • Flexibility to work 4 or 5 days per week.
  • A varied role combining accounts, e-commerce and administration.
  • Friendly, supportive working environment.
  • Opportunity to take ownership of key administrative responsibilities.

Apply

If you have accounts administration experience and enjoy a varied role, I'd love to hear from you.

Apply to Bernadette Sisson at FRS Recruitment for immediate consideration.

job.title: HR Officer
job.description:
My client based in Thurles is looking for a HR Officer to join their team. This is a permanent role, fully office based. Monday - Thursday 8-5, Friday 8-4.

Reporting to the HR Manager, this is an exciting opportunity for an enthusiastic HR professional to provide HR support in a variety of areas from recruitment, training, employee relations, rostering and admin and project works. The successful candidate will provide best in class HR support, advice, and guidance to the business as part of the HR team.

Main Responsibilities:

Rostering and Scheduling

  • Responsibility for the weekly rostering and scheduling of all flexi employees (approx. 150 employees) for a 24/7 operation
  • This is a demanding yet fulfilling responsibility with operations relying on the ability of the HR Administrator to complete the daily and weekly rosters
  • Fully responsible for ensuring all production lines are manned with the relevant key skills and general operator man power requirements
  • Producing accurate and detailed daily and weekly reports reflecting the weekly schedules, linking in all relevant reports to include, absence management, key skill fulfilment, overtime analysis, labour compare and payroll adjustments

HR and Time and Attendance System (TMS)

  • Acting as the main point of contact for all staff remuneration and benefit issues.
  • Administering all master payroll data contained on the TMS system and keeping it up to date including salary information and details on starters, leavers, and contract amendments.
  • Liaising with and supporting the payroll and finance Department on matters relating to the payroll.

Recruitment and Selection

  • Co-ordinating successful recruitment of new staff. This includes advertising new posts, screening CV’s, organising interviews, checking references, organising medicals, issuing contracts to new staff, setting up new starts on the TMS system and databases
  • Creation & updating of personnel files i.e. ensuring constant workflow on files
  • Manage the implementation of the company’s induction programme.
  • Contributing to the monitoring of new staff induction including providing support to the Managers in the probation process.

Employee Relations

  • Acting as a point of contact on all employee relations issues.
  • Assisting with promoting adherence to all relevant employment legislation and company policies and practices
  • Providing support on a variety of Industrial Relations issues including but not limited to disciplinary issues, performance issues and general compliance with policies and procedures.
  • Liaising with recognised staff representative groups

HR Administration

  • Ongoing administration and support of the Absence Management programme
  • Maintaining the rating system for the Performance Management Programme.
  • Drafting and issuing all HR correspondence to staff including, but not limited to, notice of increments, payroll amendments and changes to contract details.
  • Preparing ad-hoc letters for staff including but not limited to confirmation of employment for banks, landlords etc.
  • Maintaining all staff HR files in line with company policy and Data Protection requirements.
  • Ensuring all staff records (both on file and on Mitrefinch TMS) are kept up to date and accurate at all times.
  • Maintaining accurate records for all staff absence and leave such as sick leave, annual leave etc.
  • Preparing management reports as required.
  • Keeping all staff regularly updated on recent HR initiatives and processes.

Other Responsibilities

  • Working with the Health & Safety Committee on issues relating to Health & Safety including Health & Safety audits and proactively promoting Health & Safety compliance.
  • Managing the exit process including processing resignations or terminations in line with the defined notice period, as well as completing all exit interviews.
  • Provide up to date employment law advice to management
  • Answer general HR queries from staff and management
  • Involvement in S.W.A audits
  • Lead and deliver various projects related to staff and improving services delivered by HR and the Company
  • Conduct staff forums ensuring follow up and feedback

Recruiter: Joyce Coffey

job.title: Administrator and Operations Coordinator
job.description:
Administrator and Operations Coordinator

Purpose of role

To conduct effective coordination of Care Assistants to ensure that customers receive excellent quality care and support to keep them safe and comfortable in their own homes. A supportive and calm manner together with excellent organisational and communication skills are vital to excel in this role.

Key responsibility

Ensure that Care Assistants are appropriately rostered and allocated to customers so that care is delivered on time, safely and in line with customers wishes (as agreed in their care and support plan), and aligns with the agreed availability of Care Assistants. To strive to achieve optimised scheduling that meets the needs of both customers and carers.

Duties

  • Liaise with the Lead Coordinator and / or Registered Manager to ensure the right number of Care Assistants, with the right skills mixes, are recruited to meet the needs of the business. Arrange cover for Care Assistant sickness, absenteeism or holidays.
  • Accept, allocate and process new customer referrals for care and support promptly and effectively.
  • Process changes to customers’ required care and support needs.
  • Ensure there is sufficient cover to deliver care and support to all customers on time and in alignment with their personal care plans.
  • Monitor the restoring of Care Assistants to maximise efficiency whilst supporting them to maintain an appropriate work/ life balance.
  • Schedule Care Assistants to provide care and support to customers. Work with other members of the Care team to appropriately match Care Assistants to customers taking account of:
  1. Care Assistant skills, experience and availability to safely deliver the care and support plan;
  2. the customer’s preferences and care needs; and
  3. travel arrangements, routes and working patterns to make efficient use of Care Assistant time whilst meeting the needs of customers.
  • Make required adjustments to rotas as required to provide cover for emergency situations, to cover staff holiday or sickness, etc.
  • Distribute staff rotas at agreed intervals.
  • If required, take part in the out of hours emergency on-call rota. This will only be required after the post holder has received full training and has been assessed as competent to provide appropriate guidance and advice in emergency situations.
  • Work with the office team to maintain up to date electronic and hand written records. Use systems to record and monitor mileage and travel distances. Make sure that accidents and incidents are recorded, reported and acted upon.
  • Keep all information about customers and their families secure and confidential.
  • Carry out general office duties. Prepare reports as required as required by the Registered Manager.
  • Talk to customers and their chosen representatives about their care and support, taking account of different communication needs and levels of understanding.
  • Work with the team and other health and social care professionals to deliver high quality homecare services and to make improvements where necessary.
  • Work flexibly as part of the team and apply organisation policies and procedures at all times.

This list is not exhaustive and additional duties may be required.

Essential criteria

  • Kind and Caring – compassionate towards others who need support.
  • Professional and Respected - excellent time keeper, reliable and understanding of professional boundaries.
  • Dedicated to non-discriminatory care practice. This means respecting people suffering from a range of medical conditions with different backgrounds and beliefs to your own.
  • Innovative – strong problem-solver, who thinks outside of the box to identify solutions and opportunities.
  • Supportive – a team player and fantastic communicator, with good emotional intelligence.
  • Fun and Passionate – understand that home care can bring joy and happiness to a customers’ day, and strive to achieve this.

Knowledge and skills

  • Good understanding of the needs of people who need care and support.
  • Excellent organisational skills- proven ability to plan and organise workloads effectively so that customers receive the services they expect and are safe.
  • Ability to maintain clear and accurate written records and follow statutory reporting procedures.
  • Understanding of what confidentiality means in relation to home care services and why this is important.
  • Good administrative and IT skills. High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and build positive working relationships with customers, their families, staff and other health and social care professionals. Good telephone manner and interpersonal skills.
  • Knowledge of what confidentiality means in relation to home care services and why this is important.
  • Good geographical knowledge of the local area (roads / routes / traffic levels).
  • Ability to think clearly when under pressure. Comfortable using own initiative to solve problems or as part of a team especially in an emergency.
  • Ability and willingness to follow company’s policies, procedures and instructions

If you would like to work in an industry where you can make an impact on lives make sure to apply below.

INDFRS1

job.title: Agri Mill Operative
job.description:
Mill Operator / Production Operator

Kinsale, Co. Cork

FRS Recruitment is hiring on behalf of a leading Irish agribusiness for a Mill Operator / Production Operator to join their busy feed mill operation in Kinsale. This position would suit someone with experience in production, manufacturing, agricultural processing, feed milling, or machinery operation who is mechanically minded and comfortable working with computerised production systems.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a well-established and successful business that offers long-term career stability, training, overtime opportunities, and performance-related bonuses.

The Role

Reporting to the Production Manager, the successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring the safe, efficient, and consistent operation of the feed mill. You will be involved throughout the production process, from raw material intake and processing through to the production of finished animal feed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Operate and monitor computerised production and process control systems.
  • Manage batching, mixing, pelleting, and heat treatment processes.
  • Monitor product quality, production targets, and plant performance.
  • Manage the movement and storage of raw materials and finished products.
  • Carry out routine plant inspections, cleaning, and basic maintenance activities.
  • Identify, troubleshoot, and report mechanical or production issues.
  • Maintain accurate production, quality, and cleaning records.
  • Adhere to all health & safety, feed safety, quality assurance, and traceability procedures.
  • Assist with manual handling and general production duties as required.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives within the mill operation.

Candidate Requirements

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Experience in feed milling, food production, agricultural processing, manufacturing, or a similar production environment.
  • Experience operating computerised production or process control systems.
  • Good mechanical aptitude with the ability to perform basic maintenance tasks.
  • Strong awareness of health and safety procedures.
  • Good attention to detail and record-keeping skills.
  • The ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
  • Flexibility to work additional hours during peak seasonal periods.
  • Forklift or loader experience would be advantageous but is not essential.

What's on Offer?

  • Permanent, full-time position.
  • Guaranteed minimum of 40 hours per week.
  • Day shifts only with no night work required.
  • Typical start times of 6:00am or 7:00am, depending on seasonal production requirements.
  • Overtime opportunities available during busy periods and paid at time and a half.
  • Weekly performance-related bonus linked to production targets and KPIs.
  • Competitive hourly rate, dependent on experience and suitability.
  • Full training provided on site-specific equipment, plant, and systems.
  • Opportunity to build a long-term career within a growing and well-established Irish agribusiness.

Apply

If you have experience in production, manufacturing, agricultural operations, feed milling, or machinery operation and are looking for a secure, hands-on role with excellent long-term prospects, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today through FRS Recruitment for a confidential discussion and further details.

job.description:
Permanent | Full-Time | 78 hours per fortnight

Make a Difference in Mental Health Care

We are seeking committed and experienced nursing professionals to join a multidisciplinary healthcare team providing person-centred care to adults with a range of mental health and neuropsychiatric needs. These roles offer an opportunity to contribute to high standards of clinical practice, service development and patient wellbeing within a supportive and inclusive working environment.

The Role

The Clinical Nurse Manager will support the effective delivery and ongoing development of nursing services, ensuring care is safe, compassionate, evidence-informed and aligned with relevant national standards, legislation and regulatory requirements. The post holder will work closely with patients/residents, families, carers and colleagues across the multidisciplinary team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the strategic and operational coordination, development and management of nursing services.
  • Promote high standards of clinical care, patient safety and a therapeutic, recovery-oriented environment.
  • Ensure compliance with clinical governance, regulatory requirements, health and safety, and risk management policies.
  • Contribute to service improvement and operational change initiatives.
  • Work collaboratively with patients/residents, families, carers and multidisciplinary colleagues in care planning and goal setting.
  • Support effective staff management, workforce planning and the appropriate use of resources.
  • Contribute to the education, supervision, training and professional development of nursing staff and students.
  • Ensure nursing practices, procedures and policies support organisational and service objectives.

Essential Requirements

  • Current registration as a Registered Psychiatric Nurse with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland (NMBI), or eligibility to register where applicable.
  • Relevant post-registration nursing experience in mental health services.
  • Experience in a healthcare or hospital setting, including acute mental health care.
  • Strong clinical, organisational, managerial and administrative skills.
  • Knowledge of clinical governance, relevant mental health regulations, health and safety, and risk management.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team and demonstrate strong leadership and communication skills.
  • Commitment to ongoing professional and personal development.

Experience by Level

Clinical Nurse Manager 1 (CNM1): A minimum of three years’ post-registration nursing experience, including at least one year working in adult mental health services.

Clinical Nurse Manager 2 (CNM2): A minimum of five years’ post-qualification experience, including at least two years’ experience working as a Clinical Nurse Manager 1.

Experience in staff management, budget management and workforce planning is expected. Clinical experience in palliative care is desirable. Flexibility to work nights, weekends and public holidays may be required, depending on service needs.

What We’re Looking For

We welcome applicants who are compassionate, proactive and committed to delivering high-quality care. The successful candidate will demonstrate sound professional judgement, a collaborative approach and the ability to support colleagues while promoting safe, respectful and person-centred care.

job.title: Agri Sales Manager - Carlow
job.description:
Agri Sales Manager | Carlow

Location: Carlow Region
Job Type: Full-Time | Permanent

Join a Trusted Name in Irish Agriculture

FRS Recruitment is delighted to partner with one of Ireland's most respected and long-established agribusinesses in the search for an Agri Sales Manager covering the Carlow region.

With a proud heritage spanning over 100 years, our client has built a reputation for delivering quality products, trusted advice, and exceptional customer service to generations of farmers. As part of an ambitious growth strategy, they are now expanding their on-farm sales team and seeking an enthusiastic agricultural professional to further strengthen their presence across Carlow and the surrounding areas.

This role offers the opportunity to combine your agricultural knowledge with relationship-building and sales, helping farmers access the products and support they need to maximise farm performance.

Whether you're already working in agricultural sales or looking to take the next step from an agri merchant, co-op, feed sales, retail, or farm advisory background, this could be the opportunity you've been waiting for.

The Opportunity

As an Agri Sales Manager, you will be the face of the business across your territory, developing strong working relationships with farmers while providing practical solutions and expert advice.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and strengthen relationships with existing farm customers throughout the Carlow region.
  • Identify and secure new business opportunities to expand market share.
  • Provide on-farm advice and support across feed, fertiliser, animal health, and general farm inputs.
  • Promote the company's extensive range of agricultural products and services.
  • Build and manage a profitable customer portfolio with a focus on long-term partnerships.
  • Respond promptly to customer enquiries and deliver exceptional levels of customer service.
  • Work closely with management and internal support teams to ensure seamless customer support.
  • Meet and exceed sales targets while delivering sustainable business growth.
  • Maintain accurate customer records, sales activity, and reporting.

About You

We are seeking a driven and personable individual with a genuine passion for agriculture and a solid understanding of modern farming practices.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Agricultural qualification desirable but not essential.
  • Strong farming or agricultural background with a good understanding of livestock production and farm inputs.
  • Previous field sales experience within the agri sector would be advantageous.
  • Candidates currently working in agri retail, co-ops, merchants, animal nutrition, farm services, or technical support roles are encouraged to apply.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Commercial awareness with a customer-first approach.
  • Self-motivated and capable of managing your own territory.
  • Good IT and reporting skills.
  • Full clean driving licence.

What's on Offer?

  • Competitive salary package commensurate with experience.
  • Fully expensed company vehicle.
  • Mobile phone and laptop provided.
  • Opportunity to join a highly reputable and growing agribusiness.
  • Established customer base and strong local brand recognition.
  • Ongoing training and professional development.
  • Excellent long-term career progression opportunities.

Why Apply?

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a business that has been supporting Irish farmers for generations. You'll benefit from the backing of a respected agricultural brand while enjoying the autonomy to develop your own territory and build meaningful, long-term relationships with farmers across Carlow.

If you're passionate about agriculture, enjoy working directly with farmers, and want to be part of a business that values customer relationships and long-term growth, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply Today

To apply, please submit your CV via the link provided.

All applications will be treated in the strictest confidence. FRS Recruitment will never disclose your personal details to any third party without your prior consent.

job.title: Accounts Assistant
job.description:
Accounts Assistant

Location: Co. Offaly
Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

About the Role

We are currently recruiting an experienced Accounts Assistant to join an established motor dealership in Co Offaly.

This is a varied, hands-on role with responsibility for supporting and managing the dealership’s full day-to-day finance function. Working closely with management and the wider dealership team, the successful candidate will oversee sales and purchase ledger activities, payment runs, cash and bank reconciliations, cash flow management, vehicle sales processing and the financial administration of the parts and stocking departments.

This role would suit an organised and commercially minded accounts professional who enjoys taking ownership of the accounts function, working across different areas of the business and ensuring financial records and transactions are accurate and up to date.

Previous motor trade experience would be an advantage, but strong general accounts experience and a willingness to learn dealership-specific systems and processes are also important.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the day-to-day accounts function, including sales ledger, purchase ledger and nominal ledger postings.

  • Process supplier invoices, customer invoices, credit notes and payment runs, ensuring transactions are accurately recorded and payments are made on time.

  • Complete daily cash and bank reconciliations, including cash takings, card payments, bank lodgements and customer receipts.

  • Monitor cash flow, outstanding payments and customer balances, assisting with credit control and resolving account queries.

  • Process new and used vehicle sales, including sales invoicing, new vehicle registrations, customer deposits, part-exchanges and finance company settlements.

  • Assist with vehicle purchasing and the stocking department, including processing purchase invoices, reconciling vehicle stock records and recording associated costs.

  • Manage the financial administration of the parts and service departments, including purchase and sales invoices, supplier reconciliations and daily takings.

  • Maintain accurate nominal ledger records, allocate income and expenditure correctly, and assist with month-end reporting and reconciliations.

  • Assist with VAT returns, financial reporting, audit requirements and maintaining appropriate financial controls.

  • Liaise with management and the sales, service, parts and stocking teams to resolve discrepancies and ensure the smooth running of the finance function.

The Ideal Candidate

  • Previous experience in an Accounts Assistant or similar full-function accounts role.

  • Strong practical knowledge of sales ledger, purchase ledger, nominal ledger and bank reconciliations.

  • Experience preparing payment runs and reconciling cash and bank transactions.

  • Good understanding of cash flow management and day-to-day financial controls.

  • Strong attention to detail, organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting software.

  • A proactive approach, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities.

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work closely with colleagues across different departments.

  • Previous experience in the motor trade or a dealership environment would be a distinct advantage.

To Apply:

If you have accounts experience and are looking for a varied role where you can take responsibility for the day-to-day finance function of a busy dealership, we would love to hear from you.

job.title: Consultant Occupational Therapist
job.description:
Consultant Occupational Therapist – Westmeath

FRS Recruitment is seeking an experienced Consultant Occupational Therapist to join a service supporting individuals with intellectual disabilities (ID) and autism spectrum disorder (ASD) in Co. Westmeath.

This is an excellent opportunity for an Occupational Therapist with a strong clinical background and a genuine interest in supporting individuals to develop their independence, participation and quality of life.

The Role

  • Conduct comprehensive Occupational Therapy assessments and identify individual client needs.

  • Develop, implement and oversee tailored treatment plans and therapeutic interventions.

  • Carry out physical assessments and complete appropriate risk assessments.

  • Advise families on treatment approaches, therapeutic strategies and specialist equipment.

  • Maintain accurate clinical records in line with GDPR and clinical governance requirements.

  • Monitor client progress, coordinate discharges and provide regular service updates to management.

  • Deliver a high-quality, person-centred Occupational Therapy service in a social care setting.

Requirements

  • A recognised third-level degree in Occupational Therapy.

  • Full registration with CORU.

  • A minimum of 3 years' paid experience working as an Occupational Therapist.

  • A strong interest in working with individuals with ASD and intellectual disabilities.

  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and report-writing skills.

  • Experience managing clinical records and developing individualised treatment plans.

  • Knowledge of Occupational Therapy practices within social care settings.

  • A self-motivated approach with a commitment to high clinical standards.

  • Satisfactory Garda vetting.

Location: Co. Westmeath

If you are an experienced Occupational Therapist looking for an opportunity to make a meaningful difference in the lives of individuals with additional support needs, I would love to hear from you.

job.title: Site Supervisor / Works Coordinator
job.description:
FRS Recruitment are working with an established Civil Engineering Contractor to recruit a Site Supervisor / Works Coordinator for ongoing water and wastewater infrastructure projects across Cork City and surrounding areas.

The company have a strong reputation within the Irish construction industry, particularly in the water and wastewater sector, with an excellent pipeline of ongoing and upcoming projects across Ireland. They offer strong long-term stability and career development opportunities.

The role will involve coordinating and overseeing smaller-scale civil engineering works, primarily relating to the inspection, maintenance and repair of underground water and wastewater networks.

Projects will include CCTV surveying to identify defects within existing pipework, followed by excavation, repairs, pipe replacements and installation works where required.

This is a varied position, involving project coordination, subcontractor management, Health & Safety and general oversight of ongoing works. The role will involve a mixture of office-based responsibilities in Cork City and visits to local project sites.

The company are open to candidates from a variety of construction backgrounds, and an Engineering qualification or Trade background is not essential. Ideally, they are seeking someone who would be keen to take ownership of these operations on a long-term basis.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinate daily site activities across multiple smaller-scale infrastructure projects.
  • Oversee CCTV surveying, excavation, pipe repairs and replacement works.
  • Manage subcontractors and ensure works progress safely and efficiently.
  • Monitor Health & Safety compliance across all ongoing site operations.
  • Assist with project scheduling, planning and allocation of resources.
  • Liaise with site teams, management and relevant project stakeholders.
  • Monitor progress, quality standards and completion of ongoing works.
  • Maintain project documentation, site records and general progress reports.

Requirements

  • Previous experience within the Irish construction industry is highly desirable.
  • Experience supervising or coordinating construction works would be advantageous.
  • Good understanding of construction site Health & Safety requirements.
  • Ability to coordinate subcontractors and oversee multiple smaller projects.
  • Strong organisational, communication and problem-solving skills are essential.
  • Experience in civils, groundworks, drainage or utilities would be beneficial.
  • Comfortable working between an office environment and active construction sites.
  • Full driving licence would be highly desirable for site visits.

Salary & Benefits

  • Competitive salary package, negotiable depending on experience and background.
  • Permanent position with an established Irish Civil Engineering Contractor.
  • Projects primarily located across Cork City and surrounding areas.
  • Opportunity to take ownership of ongoing water infrastructure operations.
  • Long-term career opportunity within a well-established construction business.

job.title: CNM 2- Mental Health
job.description:
Permanent | Full-Time | 78 hours per fortnight

Make a Difference in Mental Health Care

We are seeking committed and experienced nursing professionals to join a multidisciplinary healthcare team providing person-centred care to adults with a range of mental health and neuropsychiatric needs. These roles offer an opportunity to contribute to high standards of clinical practice, service development and patient wellbeing within a supportive and inclusive working environment.

The Role

The Clinical Nurse Manager will support the effective delivery and ongoing development of nursing services, ensuring care is safe, compassionate, evidence-informed and aligned with relevant national standards, legislation and regulatory requirements. The post holder will work closely with patients/residents, families, carers and colleagues across the multidisciplinary team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the strategic and operational coordination, development and management of nursing services.
  • Promote high standards of clinical care, patient safety and a therapeutic, recovery-oriented environment.
  • Ensure compliance with clinical governance, regulatory requirements, health and safety, and risk management policies.
  • Contribute to service improvement and operational change initiatives.
  • Work collaboratively with patients/residents, families, carers and multidisciplinary colleagues in care planning and goal setting.
  • Support effective staff management, workforce planning and the appropriate use of resources.
  • Contribute to the education, supervision, training and professional development of nursing staff and students.
  • Ensure nursing practices, procedures and policies support organisational and service objectives.

Essential Requirements

  • Current registration as a Registered Psychiatric Nurse with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland (NMBI), or eligibility to register where applicable.
  • Relevant post-registration nursing experience in mental health services.
  • Experience in a healthcare or hospital setting, including acute mental health care.
  • Strong clinical, organisational, managerial and administrative skills.
  • Knowledge of clinical governance, relevant mental health regulations, health and safety, and risk management.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team and demonstrate strong leadership and communication skills.
  • Commitment to ongoing professional and personal development.

Experience by Level

Clinical Nurse Manager 1 (CNM1): A minimum of three years’ post-registration nursing experience, including at least one year working in adult mental health services.

Clinical Nurse Manager 2 (CNM2): A minimum of five years’ post-qualification experience, including at least two years’ experience working as a Clinical Nurse Manager 1.

Experience in staff management, budget management and workforce planning is expected. Clinical experience in palliative care is desirable. Flexibility to work nights, weekends and public holidays may be required, depending on service needs.

What We’re Looking For

We welcome applicants who are compassionate, proactive and committed to delivering high-quality care. The successful candidate will demonstrate sound professional judgement, a collaborative approach and the ability to support colleagues while promoting safe, respectful and person-centred care.

To know more contact Sonal Tikariha

job.title: HR Business Partner
job.description:
Human Resources Business Partner

Location: North Dublin

Office Based

Permanent full time

Salary: €50k - €60k plus 5% pension, healthcare and annual bonus

Purpose of Role

Reporting to the Head of HR, the HR Business Partner acts as the primary HR lead for their assigned region, providing practical, commercially focused people support to managers and employees throughout the employee lifecycle. This is a hands-on role requiring strong relationship-building skills, sound HR judgement and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, project-driven environment. This is an excellent opportunity for a HR professional seeking to step up into a Business Partnering role.

Responsibilities:

  • Act as the first point of contact for managers and employees on all people-related matters within the assigned region.
  • Build effective working relationships with managers to support operational and strategic business objectives.
  • Provide practical HR guidance on employee relations, performance management, absence management, conduct and capability matters.
  • Support managers in building high-performing and engaged teams.
  • Assist with workforce planning and organisational change initiatives.
  • Partner with hiring managers to identify recruitment requirements and workforce plans.
  • Support the development and review of job descriptions and role profiles.
  • Manage end-to-end recruitment processes.
  • Coordinate the onboarding process for new employees within the assigned region.
  • Ensure all employee records and documentation are maintained accurately.
  • Deliver HR inductions and support new hires through probation and integration periods.
  • Partner with managers to ensure a positive employee experience from day one.
  • Provide advice and support on disciplinary, grievance, absence, performance and conduct matters.
  • Ensure consistency, fairness and compliance in the application of company policies and procedures.
  • Escalate complex or high-risk matters to the Head of HR where appropriate.
  • Support managers in driving performance and accountability across their teams.
  • Assist with performance reviews, development discussions and talent planning activities.
  • Identify capability gaps and succession planning opportunities.
  • Work closely with the HR team to ensure regional learning and development needs are identified and addressed.
  • Manage employee movements, changes and offboarding processes.
  • Conduct exit meetings and analyse trends to support employee retention initiatives.
  • Support managers through organisational change and restructuring activities.
  • Ensure employee records within HR systems are accurate and up to date.
  • Maintain accurate employee data and documentation within BambooHR and associated systems.
  • Produce and analyse regional HR metrics and management information.
  • Monitor compliance with employment legislation and company policies.
  • Support audits and reporting requirements.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of HR processes and systems.

Skills / Qualifications:

  • 3+ years' experience in a Generalist HR role.
  • Experience supporting managers across a broad range of employee relations issues.
  • Demonstrated experience managing recruitment and onboarding activities.
  • Strong knowledge of employment legislation and HR best practice.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, multi-site environment.
  • Degree in Human Resources, Business or a related discipline.
  • CIPD qualification or equivalent professional HR accreditation preferred.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
  • Commercially focused with a practical approach to problem solving.
  • Excellent communication and influencing skills.
  • Strong organisational and time-management abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • High levels of integrity, professionalism and confidentiality.
  • Strong analytical and reporting capability.
  • Proactive, resilient and solutions-focused.

job.title: GP Nurse- No weekends
job.description:
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Salary: €50,000–€55,000 per annum (negotiable)
Hours: 36 hours per week
Working Pattern: Monday to Friday, with a half day on Wednesday
Location: In-person, GP Practice

About the Role

We are seeking a caring, enthusiastic, and experienced Practice Nurse to join our GP practice on a full-time, permanent basis.

This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated nurse with GP or primary care experience to join our practice and provide high-quality, patient-centred care in a supportive clinical environment.

The successful candidate will be confident in delivering a range of nursing services, including childhood immunisations, vaccine administration, venepuncture, ECGs, and cervical smears.

We offer a competitive salary of €50,000–€55,000 per annum, negotiable depending on experience, alongside a weekday working pattern with no weekend or bank holiday commitments.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

Duties will include, but are not limited to:

  • Providing high-quality, compassionate patient care.

  • Performing venepuncture and blood collection.

  • Carrying out ECGs.

  • Administering childhood immunisations in accordance with clinical guidelines.

  • Administering vaccines safely and effectively.

  • Performing cervical smear tests, subject to appropriate training and competence.

  • Assisting with minor surgeries and clinical procedures.

  • Performing ear syringing/ear irrigation, where appropriately trained and indicated.

  • Maintaining accurate and confidential patient records.

  • Following infection prevention and control procedures and relevant clinical protocols.

  • Supporting the GP team with the smooth day-to-day running of the practice.

  • Communicating effectively with patients, colleagues, and other healthcare professionals.

Essential Requirements

  • Current registration with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland (NMBI).

  • At least one year of experience in GP healthcare or a general practice setting.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • A professional, organised, and patient-focused approach.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.

Desirable Skills and Experience

  • Experience in childhood immunisations and vaccine administration.

  • Experience in venepuncture and ECGs.

Working closely with Site Managers and senior management, you will be responsible for managing operational information, producing performance reports, identifying areas for improvement and ensuring processes are consistent and efficient across both locations.

  • Prepare weekly and monthly reports, KPI dashboards and performance summaries for management.

  • Develop and maintain reporting templates, trackers, procedures and operational records.

  • Support the introduction and improvement of digital systems, helping to reduce manual administration and duplication.

  • Monitor outstanding actions relating to audits, compliance and operational performance.

What We're Looking For

Essential Requirements:

  • Minimum 5 years' experience in operations coordination, data management, reporting, business support or a similar role.

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, formulas, lookups, charts and data validation.

  • Ability to identify inefficiencies and suggest improvements to existing processes.

  • Excellent organisational skills with strong attention to detail.

  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.

Desirable:

We are looking for someone who is more than just an experienced administrator. The successful candidate will be comfortable working with data, spotting issues, improving how things are done and providing management with clear, useful information.

You will be someone who takes initiative, works well independently and enjoys finding smarter, more efficient ways of working.

job.title: Cath Lab Nurse
job.description:
Job Description

Job Title: CNM1 and Staff Nurse

Department: Cardiac Catheterisation Laboratory
Reports to: Nurse Manager / CNM2
Date: 2026

Overall Purpose of the Role

The organisation is committed to providing exceptional patient care within an environment where quality, respect, compassion and dignity are central to all aspects of care delivery.

The Clinical Coordinator is responsible for coordinating, directing and overseeing the day-to-day clinical and operational activities of the Cardiac Catheterisation Laboratory. The post holder will work collaboratively with the Cardiac Catheterisation Laboratory team and the wider Cardiology multidisciplinary team to ensure the delivery of safe, effective and high-quality patient care.

Key Responsibilities and Deliverables

The Clinical Coordinator will:

  • Coordinate and oversee the daily delivery of patient care within the unit.

  • Assess patient care requirements and analyse workload and staffing needs to ensure appropriate allocation of resources.

  • Assess staff competencies and allocate patient care responsibilities appropriately.

  • Delegate duties and responsibilities in accordance with legal and professional requirements, departmental policies and established standards.

  • Maintain effective communication with the Nurse Manager regarding operational requirements, patient care concerns, staffing issues and incidents.

  • Act as a clinical and professional resource for staff within the unit.

  • Provide direct patient care and clinical support when required.

  • Identify and maintain appropriate internal controls within the department and contribute to mechanisms that monitor compliance.

  • Ensure adherence to departmental policies, procedures, guidelines and internal controls.

  • Undertake other duties appropriate to the role as required.

Clinical Responsibilities

The post holder will:

  • Practise in accordance with the relevant professional standards and the Professional Scope of Practice Framework issued by the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland (NMBI).

  • Maintain a high standard of clinical practice and professional conduct.

  • Promote safe, evidence-based and patient-centred care.

  • Ensure that patient care is delivered in accordance with organisational policies, procedures and clinical guidelines.

  • Support the delivery of high-quality care within the Cardiac Catheterisation Laboratory.

  • Escalate clinical concerns and patient safety issues appropriately and promptly.

Managerial Responsibilities

The post holder will:

  • Identify and communicate operational, clinical and staffing issues to the Nurse Manager in a timely manner.

  • Demonstrate knowledge and competence in relevant organisational policies, procedures and clinical guidelines.

  • Ensure that all required clinical and operational documentation is completed accurately and in a timely manner.

  • Respond appropriately to patient and service-user complaints and escalate concerns where necessary.

  • Monitor and contribute to risk management processes within the department.

  • Promote effective communication and collaboration across the multidisciplinary team.

  • Ensure the efficient and appropriate use of human, financial and other departmental resources.

  • Participate in unit and hospital-wide nursing communication processes.

  • Support the Nurse Manager in maintaining effective standards of service delivery.

Supervisory Responsibilities

The post holder will:

  • Allocate patient workloads appropriately, taking into consideration patient acuity, clinical requirements, staff competence and skill mix.

  • Provide direct and indirect supervision to Staff Nurses, Healthcare Assistants and unit reception staff as appropriate.

  • Monitor the delivery of patient care and provide guidance and support to staff.

  • Promote a safe, supportive and professional working environment.

  • Identify and escalate performance, competency or staffing concerns appropriately.

Interprofessional Relationships

The post holder will:

  • Develop and maintain effective working relationships with all relevant departments, medical staff, patients, families and external agencies.

  • Maintain effective communication with the Nurse Manager and Nurse Supervisor throughout the shift.

  • Demonstrate effective delegation of duties and responsibilities.

  • Participate in ongoing consultation and collaboration with physicians and other members of the multidisciplinary team to optimise patient outcomes and achieve unit-specific objectives.

  • Promote effective communication and teamwork within the clinical environment.

  • Demonstrate a willingness to support colleagues and assist with workload when required.

  • Promote a culture of respect, professionalism and collaborative practice.

Quality Improvement and Risk Management

The post holder will actively participate in quality management and continuous improvement processes, contributing to:

  • The identification and review of quality, policy and guideline issues.

  • The evaluation of current clinical practices against evidence-based and best-practice standards.

  • The development and implementation of appropriate clinical and operational standards using structure, process and outcome measures.

  • Hospital, regional and national audit processes.

  • Accreditation and quality-assurance processes.

  • Health promotion and patient education initiatives.

  • The identification and implementation of opportunities to improve patient safety, quality of care and service delivery.

  • The monitoring and review of clinical risks and implementation of appropriate risk-reduction measures.

  • Educational Responsibilities

Under the direction of the Nurse Manager, the post holder will:

  • Develop and utilise effective teaching and facilitation skills within the clinical environment.

  • Participate in the planning, implementation and evaluation of orientation and clinical teaching programmes for student nurses.

  • Provide appropriate feedback to Nurse Managers to support the completion of student nurse proficiency assessments.

  • Contribute to the identification of education and training needs within the clinical area.

  • Identify and contribute to the development of learning opportunities for staff within the department.

  • Participate in the clinical induction and orientation of newly appointed nursing and support staff.

  • Develop leadership skills and act as a positive and effective professional role model.

  • Support staff development through appropriate coaching, supervision and feedback.

  • Take responsibility for identifying and addressing personal learning and professional development needs.

Person Specification

Qualifications

Essential:

  • Current registration with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland (NMBI) as a Registered General Nurse, with registration maintained in good standing.

  • Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification.

  • Current Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) certification.

Desirable:

  • Relevant postgraduate qualification or specialist education in cardiology, cardiac nursing, cardiac catheterisation or a related area.

  • Where a relevant postgraduate qualification is not currently held, willingness to undertake an appropriate postgraduate programme within 18 months of commencing the Clinical Coordinator role.

Experience

The successful candidate will ideally have:

  • A minimum of two years' relevant clinical experience within a Cardiac Catheterisation Laboratory.

  • Demonstrable experience in clinical leadership and coordination.

  • Experience in teaching, mentoring and supporting nursing and healthcare staff.

  • Experience of working effectively within a multidisciplinary team.

  • Demonstrable professional judgement and the ability to make appropriate clinical decisions.

  • Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills.

  • The ability to prioritise and manage multiple tasks effectively within a busy clinical environment.

  • Effective time-management and organisational skills.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • A commitment to continuing professional development and lifelong learning.

  • The ability to communicate effectively in written and spoken English, with a high standard of grammar and professional communication.

To know more contact Sonal Tikariha

job.title: QC Validation Specialist
job.description:
Seeking a QC Validation Specialist !

This position plays a critical role in ensuring analytical methods are properly designed, validated and transferred in alignment with EU/FDA GMP requirements for advanced therapy products.

We are particularly interested in speaking with candidates who have hands-on experience designing validation studies, as well as authoring and reviewing validation protocols and reports—not just executing test methods developed by others. A genuine understanding of the regulatory landscape and the rationale behind validation activities is essential.

The Role

In this position, you will:

  • Lead and support the development, validation and technology transfer of new and established analytical methods for gene therapy products.

  • Design validation studies and generate validation protocols, data analysis summaries and comprehensive reports.

  • Ensure analytical methods are fully validated and transferred into QC GMP laboratories in line with regulatory expectations (EU/FDA, ICH Q2(R1), GMP, data integrity).

  • Create, update and maintain method SOPs and technical documentation.

  • Provide clear communication and progress updates to cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Conduct routine assessments of analytical methods to ensure continued control and suitability.

  • Support Quality Management System activities, including document control and data integrity oversight.

  • Maintain and track personal training, GMP compliance and document lifecycle responsibilities (deviations, CAPAs, change controls).

  • When required, perform analytical testing of gene therapy products according to approved specifications.

Candidate Profile

  • A degree or Master’s in a scientific discipline (e.g., Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry).

  • Approx. 2+ years’ experience in the pharmaceutical, biologics, or a similarly regulated environment.

  • Demonstrated experience in method validation, including:

    • Designing validation studies,

    • Writing and reviewing protocols and validation reports,

    • A strong understanding of regulatory requirements and data integrity.

  • Experience with analytical techniques (advantageous but not essential): qPCR, HPLC (RP-HPLC/SEC), ELISA, SDS-PAGE/Western blot, cell culture, DNA extraction.

  • Strong understanding of ICH Q2(R1).

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Keywords: QC Validation Chemist, Method Transfer Chemist, Analytical Chemist, Scientist, Chemist, Analytical Chemist, Scientist,Chemist, HPLC,GMP

Job overview

To plan and organize assigned farm mechanical maintenance staff so that the broad range of agricultural, industrial and animal feeding machinery and equipment is serviced, maintained and operated in accordance with company procedure. job.title: Talent & Retention Lead
job.description:
Talent Acquisition & Retention Lead - HGV / Driver

Permanent full time

Location: Co. Cavan

Office based - Potential flexibility post probation

Overview:

You’ll own the full driver journey, from recruitment and onboarding through to engagement and retention. Working closely with the Driver Management Team, you’ll develop innovative initiatives that strengthen our driver proposition and create a supportive, engaging environment where drivers feel valued and motivated to stay.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute the company's annual and seasonal driver recruitment strategy and plans to meet workforce plans / targets.
  • Recruit drivers through multiple channels including but not limited to; existing driver networks, alumni drivers, employee referrals, social media, recruitment agencies, driver training schools, apprenticeship programs, international recruitment initiatives, job boards and specialist transport recruitment platforms
  • Oversee the design, content and effectiveness of the company's driver recruitment website and related company digital recruitment platforms.
  • Manage all recruitment expenditure and operate within agreed budgets.
  • Establish partnerships with external training organisations and educational bodies and develop and manage internal driver apprenticeships and trainee programmes.
  • Manage and continuously improve driver referral bonus scheme.
  • Maximise recruitment conversion rates, reduce recruitment costs, and time invested through continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Design and manage all driver screening and selection processes.
  • Develop selection criteria to ensure the recruitment of high-performing drivers who align with company values.
  • Coordinate Interviews, Assessments, driving evaluations, Qualification & Certifications Compliance and right to work employment checks and medical assessments where required
  • Manage candidate and business stakeholder expectations throughout the recruitment process.
  • Design, implement and manage structured onboarding programs.
  • Ensure probation reviews are completed for all drivers within 1 month, co-ordinate review & sign off for Head of Driver Management and transition successful candidates to Performance & Comp Lead.
  • Develop and execute the annual driver engagement plan with initiatives designed to improve recruitment conversion, reduce turnover, identify flight risks and improve employee satisfaction e.g. establish regular structured driver engagement (surveys, direct phone calls),
  • Develop and maintain a Driver Buddy Program to assist with onboarding and integration.
  • Develop and execute the company's driver-focused social media strategy.
  • Ensure driver feedback (concerns and suggestions) are collated and shared (with relevant staff promptly e.g. planning, garage or driver mgt team), concluded (actions / decision) and response (feedback / decisions) is provided.
  • Implement action plans to address driver attrition risks.
  • Monitor and analyse driver turnover trends and identify root causes by conducting stay interviews and exit interviews.

Skills / Qualifications:

  • 3+ years’ recruitment experience, with proven experience delivering multi-channel recruitment campaigns across job boards, websites and social media.
  • Experience recruiting international staff a bonus with navigating Irish immigration requirements, including employment permits, IRP permissions, visa requirements, and related work authorisation processes.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and influencing skills, with the ability to manage difficult conversations with empathy.
  • Proven track record in recruitment, retention, employee engagement and workforce planning, with a focus on delivering positive outcomes.
  • Strong IT, analytical and reporting skills, including Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and similar systems.
  • Experience managing budgets and delivering measurable operational improvements.
  • Highly organised, proactive and self-motivated, with the ability to multitask, work independently, and demonstrate a willingness to learn and progress.
  • Experience in employer branding and social media recruitment.

job.title: Product Application Engineer
job.description:
Location: UK & Ireland | Full-time

The Role

An exciting opportunity is available for an experienced Product Application Engineer to join a growing Low Voltage Distribution Switchgear Centre of Excellence.

This is a customer-facing technical role supporting utility, renewable energy and industrial markets. The successful candidate will translate customer requirements into practical, technically sound and commercially viable solutions, working closely with Sales, Engineering, Product Management and Operations.

  • Support customer prequalification, technical approvals and vendor onboarding.

  • Provide application and technical support to customers, partners and Sales teams.

  • Support product selection, specification and solution design.

  • Identify customer and market requirements and translate them into development opportunities.

  • Support product testing, validation, field trials and new product introductions.

  • Develop technical documentation, application guides and training materials.

  • Represent the organisation at customer meetings, industry events and technical forums.

About You

The ideal candidate will have:

  • A degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.

  • 5+ year's experience in utility, electrical distribution, renewable energy or industrial markets.

  • Experience in application engineering, product development, technical sales or product management.

  • Knowledge of low- and medium-voltage distribution systems and associated products.

  • Understanding of relevant industry standards, utility specifications and product qualification processes.

  • Experience with product testing, validation and qualification.

Benefits include:

  • Competitive salary

  • Professional development and training

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced electrical engineer looking to combine technical expertise, commercial awareness and customer engagement in a growing energy technology environment.

job.title: Poultry Farm Manager
job.description:
FRS Recruitment are currently recruiting for Poultry Farm Managers and Assistant Farm Managers for a large-scale poultry farm operation in Saudi Arabia. These are full-time permanent roles.

Given to the vast scale of operations, we have varied opportunities across Broiler, Breeding, Hatchery, Laying, Layer, Egg Production, Rearing, etc so if you have a strong interest in Poultry farm management and specialise in one or more areas please consider applying today.

You will be responsible for the following duties:

  • Manage the farm if both the Farm Manager and Sr. Farm Manager are absent to ensure the operational efficiency and smooth running of the unit
  • Ensure to motivate your staff to achieve ever-greater levels of efficiency in all aspects of their work and develop their potential skills to benefit the individual and the company.
  • Monitor and assess the performance of your Unit managers and Unit Herdsmen providing guidance and support to ensure that they and their unit achieve the budgeted level of performance.
  • To plan in conjunction with your Unit Managers and Herdsmen the annual vacations of all your staff with a view to ensuring adequate levels of manpower on site at all times.
  • Assess the levels of feed intake and Egg or Broiler production on a daily basis, compare with targets and take corrective action as required.
  • In conjunction with the Div. Poultry Manager and Farm Manager, to assist in the preparation of a capital and revenue budget for the coming year for approval of GM Farming.
  • Implement the provisions of the Bio-Security policy on the farm at all times.
    • Functional Areas are: be Rearing, Laying, Egg Store, Feedmill, Breeding, Broiler or Hatcheries, Health
    • Subordinates range from 66 to 214 men.
    • Animal handling range from 6000 to 25,400 animals according to the farm.

Candidate profile and experience required

  • 5 - 10 years’ experience in the management of Poultry
  • Hands on livestock management skills
  • Must have good management skills, influencing skills, good communication skills, computer literate and driving license
  • Must have the ability to work in a remote environment, with a multi nationality workforce, on a handson role within the business.

Remuneration

  • Attractive Tax Free Salary
  • Yearly Bonus based KPI system
  • Severance
  • Medical Cover
  • Vehicle
  • 98 days annual leave a year. (6 weeks on 2-3 weeks of roster)

job.title: Quality Manager
job.description:
Quality Manager-Cork

Excellent salary package + bonus, pension & healthcare

Please note: This position is open to candidates who already have the legal right to work in Ireland. Visa sponsorship or work permit support is not available for this position.

A well-established Cork based food manufacturer is continuing to expand its operations and is now seeking an experienced Quality Manager to join the team.

The business manufactures a wide range of nutritional products serving multiple sectors, with a strong focus on quality, food/feed safety, compliance and continuous improvement.

The business is undergoing significant expansion, including the construction of a new production facility and a major increase in manufacturing capacity. This is an excellent opportunity to play a key role in developing and strengthening the Quality function as the business grows.

Reporting to the Operations Manager, you will be responsible for:

  • Lead and manage the Quality function across all manufacturing operations, ensuring strong quality performance, product release and robust compliance systems.
  • Maintain effective traceability and batch record systems, ensuring accuracy, integrity and accessibility of records.
  • Lead regulatory and certification compliance, ensuring adherence to DAFM, HACCP, UFAS, NOPS, GMP+ and relevant customer and industry standards.
  • Manage the Quality Management System (QMS) and document control processes.
  • Develop and oversee the analytical testing programme, using HACCP and risk assessment principles.
  • Lead the internal audit programme and manage all external audits and regulatory inspections, ensuring findings are addressed promptly.
  • Oversee supplier approval, raw material change control and cross-functional assessment of quality and regulatory impacts.
  • Manage the customer complaints process, ensuring effective investigation, corrective action and timely closure.
  • Lead non-conformance, root cause analysis and corrective action, driving continuous improvement across the site.
  • Monitor and trend key quality and site performance metrics, leading quality review meetings and follow-up actions.
  • Develop team capability through effective training, coaching and support.
  • Work closely with Operations, Technical, Commercial and other functions to deliver site objectives and maintain high standards of quality and compliance.

Experience & Skills

  • Prior experience as a Quality Manager in a production processing environment
  • 10 years minimum experience in a pharma or food production environment.
  • Degree in a Science related subject
  • Level 5 or higher HACCP certification
  • Strong leadership and management skills
  • Excellent understanding of Food Safety and Quality Management Systems, with strong knowledge of food/feed legislation, customer standards and Codes of Practice
  • Formal Audit Training / Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor experience

What's in it for you?

  • Excellent salary package DOE
  • Performance-related bonus
  • Pension
  • Healthcare
  • Opportunity to join a business undergoing significant expansion
  • Major investment in a new production facility
  • Opportunity to play a key role in developing and strengthening the Quality function as the business grows

Please note: This position is open to candidates who already have the legal right to work in Ireland. Visa sponsorship or work permit support is not available for this position.
